environment: Public official documentation searched by web retrieval. Raw source HTTP status, redirects, body content and iOS Share host behavior were not probed.
purpose: Ground contract expectations without misreporting app/backend functionality. Source documentation is not a recipe extraction test.

observations.evidence: ReciMe describes a TikTok Share workflow using caption, audio and a possible original website as sequential content sources.
observations.limitations: Public feature description only, not access to a TikTok video, article body, platform API or native Share receipt.

observations.evidence: Supabase shows durable queue messages consumed by an Edge Function and removed after processing; failures leave them available for retry.
observations.limitations: Documentation only: not evidence of deployed RecipePouch import routes, queue or worker.
